title: Show HN: StartupWiki – A Free Alternative to Crunchbase
summary: StartupWiki is a free, open startup database that provides company information without requiring accounts, subscriptions, or complex metrics - designed to feel like Wikipedia for startup research.
problem_solved: Eliminates barriers to accessing early-stage startup information by providing a free, no-signup-required alternative to paid databases like Crunchbase.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to startup data for entrepreneurs, investors, and researchers who previously had to pay for or sign up to access similar information.
